title: PDS Limited promotes Abhishekh Kanoi as Group General Counsel
description: PDS Limited has promoted Abhishekh Kanoi to the position of Group General Counsel.Kanoi has over 19 years of experience navigating diverse industries and complex ecosystems across India and South Asia.
